Madhuri Dixit's Husband Unfamiliar with Bollywood Stars at Wedding

Dr. Shriram Nene, husband of actress Madhuri Dixit, did not recognize Bollywood stars Shah Rukh Khan and Salman Khan at their wedding. He reportedly only recognized one other Bollywood star at the reception. Madhuri Dixit and Dr. Nene married in 1999 and lived in the US before returning to India, where they now reside in Mumbai with their two sons, Arin and Ryan.
